State_change_caption: As the sequence progresses, the onion skin undergoes a subtle transformation in response to the hands' movements. Initially laid out loosely on the cutting board, it becomes a secondary participant in the dance of meal prep, its position shifting with each new action. The texture of the skin changes from being slightly pliable and glossy to drier and more curled, echoing the natural progression of being separated from its original form. This progression showcases the interplay between the food preparer and the ingredients, with the onion skin serving as a delicate reminder of the ongoing preparation process.
